meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按代码的语法结构而不是文字来搜索和改写:找出所有形如某个模式的函数、调用、类或导入,做批量改写(codemod),也能扫描或应用 YAML 规则。支持 25 种语言。
howto.when: 当你要找或改的是语法形状(如每个形如 X 的调用、类、导入,或 codemod、YAML 规则)而非字面文本时触发;如果是纯字符串、注释、文件名,则改用 rg。

say.text: 把仓库里所有 console.log(x) 改成 logger.info(x)
say.note: 先给预览,确认后再写入文件

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
扫描 src/ 下的 YAML 规则并列出违规
say.note: 运行 sg scan 输出违规项

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by AST shape rather than literal text: finding every function, call, class, or import shaped like a pattern, running codemods, and scanning or applying YAML rules. Works across 25 languages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is a syntax shape (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, or a YAML rule) rather than literal text; use rg for plain strings, comments, or filenames.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) across the repo to logger.info(x)
say_en.note: Shows a dry-run preview first, then applies

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter
Scan the YAML rules under src/ and list violations
say_en.note: Runs sg scan and reports violations
